notes.manas-2010:p1329:b001:l005: Battle-axe bending at its middle is literal; no replacement with a broken spear.
notes.manas-2010:p1329:b001:l015: Six by six is retained for the forty companions; not forced to divide evenly.
notes.manas-2010:p1329:b001:l016: Potential flight explains blocking the twelve khans' people; the source does not explicitly name who might flee. English keeps the pronoun ambiguous.
notes.manas-2010:p1329:b001:l023: Bakay compared to a rooster is retained literally, with his hands behind his back in the next line.
notes.manas-2010:p1329:b001:l025: Желбегей provisionally takes loosely draped clothing while walking; no new armor supplied.
notes.manas-2010:p1329:b001:l031: Меке is Mecca and Төмөнкү below/lower, but дылда has no established primary Kyrgyz meaning or secure place-name identification here. Exact parallels1661:l005 and1820:l018 do not resolve it. Whole verse preserved raw/transliteration outside English count, no guessed gilded-city or Medina emendation. Completion-first first pass: Best-effort rendering from a close formulaic parallel; retain for specialist review because the source was previously unresolved.
notes.manas-2010:p1329:b001:l033: Ыймандык refers broadly to services/rites of faith; later Aykhozho explicitly serves as imam and is asked to perform marriages.
notes.manas-2010:p1329:b001:l038: Сүйүнчү asks for the customary reward for bringing good news, rather than merely meaning congratulations.
notes.manas-2010:p1329:b001:l039: The odd costly-pleasure/dreadful-business wording remains in Syrgak's rallying speech; no missing clause is invented.
notes.manas-2010:p1329:b001:l040: Динистам is an epic form of дин-ислам, Islam; here an address to the faithful, not an untranslated utterance. https://el-sozduk.kg/дин/
notes.manas-2010:p1330:b001:l004: Syrgak's claim to have taken Beijing is explicitly called a lie by Muzburchak at p1334:l027; narrative inconsistency is part of the recruitment ruse, not corrected away.
notes.manas-2010:p1330:b001:l007: Уз can describe a skilled woman/craftswoman, here among beautiful female captives; rendered craftswomen, with the beauty emphasis carried by surrounding verses.
notes.manas-2010:p1330:b001:l009: Thimble-mouth and camel-calf-eyes are literal ideal-beauty comparisons, retained as such.
notes.manas-2010:p1330:b001:l014: Агача келин follows Yudakhin fair-faced young beauty in this exact phrase, rather than the explanatory dictionary's alternative older stately woman. https://el-sozduk.kg/?lfrom=ru&lto=xx&page=main&word=АГА
notes.manas-2010:p1330:b001:l015: Үптөө takes the women as objects of plunder; the dehumanizing spoils claim is not softened to voluntary marriage.
notes.manas-2010:p1330:b001:l021: Өлбөгөн жерде literally a place where they did not die, retained as the peculiar boast; no silent emendation to an idyllic or immortal realm.
notes.manas-2010:p1330:b001:l028: Gold shoes are on the captured pacers; not human footwear.
notes.manas-2010:p1330:b001:l034: Жаң-жуң is the governor-general title of Birmyskal's father; no unprinted personal-name Ay prefix supplied.
notes.manas-2010:p1331:b001:l002: Printed ике provisionally read нике in the established нике кый marriage formula; dropped initial н noted, raw unchanged.
notes.manas-2010:p1331:b001:l010: Идерлүү means strong/capable in the local glossary p1838:l011. Courser and young man are both present, not silently collapsed to only a rider.
notes.manas-2010:p1331:b001:l018: The object of алып кайтар is omitted in raw; spoils inferred from the next explicit plunder line.
notes.manas-2010:p1331:b001:l027: Искендер is Iskender/Alexander; Beijing untouched by him is an epic claim, not translator-certified history.
notes.manas-2010:p1331:b001:l029: Printed Эгерде conditional is syntactically awkward with the categorical negative; English then links it to the journey and following death condition, without inventing a missing protasis.
notes.manas-2010:p1331:b001:l037: Madykan's mount is explicitly a blue bull with a snout horn, retained as an epic creature; not relabeled a rhinoceros.
notes.manas-2010:p1331:b001:l041: Terminal Latin I visible in the PDF is treated as a stray punctuation-like glyph after бар, not another number or verse; full raw display line remains recorded.
notes.manas-2010:p1332:b001:l006: l006–007 gives Madykan's threat within the fearful speakers' report, not an intention to kill their own Manas.
notes.manas-2010:p1332:b001:l021: Дыйкан, husbandman, metaphorically productive/masterful wisdom, paired with river; rendered fertile river, preserving the cultivation image broadly.
notes.manas-2010:p1332:b001:l024: Compressed object clause about Beijing and forty khans retained within the letter-reading, without pretending the khans are the readers.
notes.manas-2010:p1332:b001:l031: Military decimal leaders are glossed as leaders of tens, fifties, hundreds and thousands; no modern ranks substituted.
notes.manas-2010:p1333:b001:l003: Clear sky/overcast earth recurs during armies raising dust; not harmonized to a cloudy sky.
notes.manas-2010:p1333:b001:l031: Printed камданын read камданып in the preparation participle; raw terminal н unchanged.
notes.manas-2010:p1333:b001:l035: Obscene кызыталак occurs in an admiring description of ally Muzburchak; not suppressed or reassigned to an enemy.
notes.manas-2010:p1333:b001:l040: The pale stars line remains even though it interrupts the hero-description and friendship statement.
notes.manas-2010:p1334:b001:l001: Кырым rendered Crimea in the epic geography; no claim about historical sovereignty or actual route.
notes.manas-2010:p1334:b001:l003: Muzburchak has just turned twenty-five; exact age retained.
notes.manas-2010:p1334:b001:l019: Көрөгөч is the addressed companion Körögöch here, though the word also means perceptive/far-seeing; not replaced with an unnamed official.
notes.manas-2010:p1334:b001:l034: The explanation explicitly contradicts Syrgak's spoils boast: Manas is surrounded because Aybanboz cannot move. Both reports preserved.
notes.manas-2010:p1334:b001:l040: Арман understood as unfulfilled desire/regret in the offer to die rescuing Manas; rhetorical force retained, not a promise of easy victory.
notes.manas-2010:p1335:b001:l003: Бүлөө, sharpening/whetting, applied metaphorically to preparing warriors.
notes.manas-2010:p1335:b001:l010: Домбутуп provisionally associated with Yudakhin домбулт-, make dash/advance; does not assert physical swelling. https://el-sozduk.kg/домбу/
notes.manas-2010:p1335:b001:l017: Twelve san retained as the epic multitude measure without invented exact equivalence.
notes.manas-2010:p1335:b001:l029: Sart is the source ethnonym; the following derogatory reliability/backache comparisons belong to the source narrator and are retained.
notes.manas-2010:p1335:b001:l042: Жоон өпкө, stout-lunged, retains the physical/booming-voice characterization; no modern diagnosis.
notes.manas-2010:p1336:b001:l004: Алаш is the legendary forefather in the Kazakh description, retained as Alash.
notes.manas-2010:p1336:b001:l005: The boots/heels wording is a compressed nominal fragment; no unsupported height or heel material added.
notes.manas-2010:p1336:b001:l009: Millet husked clean as stone is the source's unusual comparison; not repaired to a different food or action.
notes.manas-2010:p1336:b001:l012: Kökchö expressly rides Kögala here; not changed because Chubak also rides a similarly named horse.
notes.manas-2010:p1336:b001:l020: Кулача is dun coloring, per shared primary lexicon, not a separate horse name.
notes.manas-2010:p1336:b001:l021: Тумарча is amulet-shaped forehead marking in the horse-color description; an actual tied amulet remains a possible reading.
notes.manas-2010:p1336:b001:l022: Көйкашка rendered outstanding in this praise formula, following primary көйкашка; not an invented breed. https://el-sozduk.kg/koy-12/
notes.manas-2010:p1336:b001:l023: Кара байыр is the Karabayyr horse designation; казанат battle steed. No exact modern breeding claim.
notes.manas-2010:p1336:b001:l036: Night thieving is explicitly attributed to ally Zhamgyrchy; retained without sanitization.
notes.manas-2010:p1336:b001:l042: One san repeats the quantified Eshtek army; no conversion to a fixed count.
notes.manas-2010:p1337:b001:l001: Эки-Кемин kept as Eki-Kemin; not silently normalized to Eki-Kem or the Yenisei.
notes.manas-2010:p1337:b001:l003: Күздүк, winter-sown crop, retained for rice despite agricultural oddness.
notes.manas-2010:p1337:b001:l004: Күрмөк is small-grained weed growing with rice, used here as tethered-stock feed; not the homographic jacket. https://el-sozduk.kg/күрмө/
notes.manas-2010:p1337:b001:l007: Куюккан provisionally scattered/distressed people in the repeated gathering-wanderers formula; exact lexical nuance uncertain.
notes.manas-2010:p1337:b001:l008: Телик куш is a small falcon (or skilled hunting bird in epic use), not a stray bird; Yudakhin cites the exact train-into-a-hunting-bird formula. https://el-sozduk.kg/телик/
notes.manas-2010:p1337:b001:l013: Астында Үрбү read as Ürbü at the front; no unnamed mount introduced. The next line also places the host before him; loose order retained.
notes.manas-2010:p1337:b001:l021: Ар күрөңүн provisionally joined as the horse name Arküröng in Shygay's riding formula; raw spacing retained.
notes.manas-2010:p1337:b001:l027: Кызыл баш is Kyzylbash, the source collective label, not a modern nationality assignment.
notes.manas-2010:p1337:b001:l030: Эндей provisionally plain cloth in the shirt description; precise fiber not asserted.
notes.manas-2010:p1338:b001:l006: Сырттан is a powerful beast/champion epithet; rendered great beast without inventing a specific species.
notes.manas-2010:p1338:b001:l014: Printed Чайынги is a variant of Töshtük's named coat Chayyngi, not an unidentified metal adjective: primary Kyrgyz Manas vol2 PDF p17 has Чайыңги деген тон кийип paired with Chalkuyruk and Eleman's youngest son. Web text inspected; remote screenshot failed404, so no claim to visual review of that external page. https://new.bizdin.kg/media/books/Manas-eposu-2-tom_t7Xe9ZO.pdf
notes.manas-2010:p1338:b001:l021: Earth's corrosion after seven years underground is the source metaphor; not replaced with aging, disease, or literal rusted metal.
notes.manas-2010:p1338:b001:l035: Календер and дубана are separately rendered dervish and holy mendicant; no invented proper names.
notes.manas-2010:p1338:b001:l037: Right shoulder specifically retained, not generalized to two broad shoulders.
notes.manas-2010:p1339:b001:l002: Five years of study in Egypt/Mecca is the epic biography as stated; not independently verified history.
notes.manas-2010:p1339:b001:l010: Printed эл айтат provisionally read as speaking to the people by the following кеп айтат; no silent claim that raw has эр.
notes.manas-2010:p1339:b001:l035: Үзүк is yurt roof-felt, used as an extravagant hat-size comparison; Shuutu remains a personal name.
notes.manas-2010:p1339:b001:l038: Muzburchak is expressly behind the army here despite earlier being in front; no relocation imposed.
notes.manas-2010:p1340:b001:l001: Boiling bitter brine is retained as the army/ordeal image; not changed to a named salt lake.
notes.manas-2010:p1340:b001:l005: l005–009 are narrator uncertainty formulas about falsehood/truth and no eyewitness, all retained as verse rather than editorial apparatus.
notes.manas-2010:p1340:b001:l029: One thousand Chinese to one Burut retained as the stated ratio.
notes.manas-2010:p1340:b001:l032: Жекене is leather belt, Yudakhin exact waist-girding formula and local glossary1837:l034. https://el-sozduk.kg/жекен/
notes.manas-2010:p1340:b001:l034: Seventy thousand is explicit миң, retained without turning it into an unspecified multitude.
notes.manas-2010:p1341:b001:l006: Körögöch is captured while Muzburchak escapes on Telkyzyl; no rescue or death supplied here.
notes.manas-2010:p1341:b001:l010: Ten directions of tears is the literal extravagant formula, not an omitted numeral.
notes.manas-2010:p1341:b001:l018: Request for Manas's coat is explicit; no unprinted transfer is added.
notes.manas-2010:p1341:b001:l026: Manas now rides Akkula and uses Akkelte; the change from exhausted Aybanboz remains as printed without inventing a transition in this batch.
notes.manas-2010:p1342:b001:l038: Head as bucket of blood retained literally; singular generic wording rendered plurally with the soldiers.
notes.manas-2010:p1343:b001:l009: Stones seething is the printed comparison; no silent emendation to ants or sand.
notes.manas-2010:p1343:b001:l018: Covering themselves with an ear is the giants' explicit winter trait, not removed as implausible.
notes.manas-2010:p1343:b001:l025: Swift Foot-Runners is the translated epic people-description, not a newly identified historical ethnicity.
notes.manas-2010:p1343:b001:l030: Кан taken as blood in the engulfing battle, though khan is possible; interpretation explicitly qualified rather than silently fixing source.
notes.manas-2010:p1343:b001:l038: Дуңчу is interpreter: Yudakhin дуңчу and the Chinese-loanword study citing Karasaev. Captive labor is explicit; not silently rendered eunuch or slaughter. https://tamgasoft.kg/dict/index.php?alf1=д&alf2=ду&cur_page=4&dic_id=2&page=list_words ; https://lib.knu.kg/files/2010/vest_2010_6_seriya_1_vypusk_KKI.pdf
notes.manas-2010:p1343:b001:l042: The encountering subject is Mangkush, named immediately on the next page; Kozubek is the Sart khan encountered.
notes.manas-2010:p1344:b001:l001: Дадалатып takes the Sarts' cry dada, father; the taunting cry is translated, not retained as an untranslated full line.
notes.manas-2010:p1344:b001:l013: Айт is the warning/exhortation Hey here, repeated with Kokand; not an instruction to say the place name.
notes.manas-2010:p1344:b001:l019: Four Companions religious conquest formula retained; no historical claim by translator.
notes.manas-2010:p1344:b001:l037: Алтын айдар is golden forelock and чок белбоо tasselled sash in Almambet's appearance; no literal fire on the belt.
notes.manas-2010:p1345:b001:l011: Raw Маңкуштун has a genitive ending; l010–013 syntactically defective. Provisionally Mangkush is Almambet's target, explicitly confirmed l023; no raw repair.
notes.manas-2010:p1345:b001:l012: Бакай кандын далына literally toward Khan Bakay's back; provisionally locates Mangkush behind Bakay, since Almambet's blow fells Mangkush (l017–023). The attachment remains uncertain.
notes.manas-2010:p1345:b001:l020: Achbolot here belongs to Bakay in the source; no replacement with another sword to enforce ownership consistency.
notes.manas-2010:p1345:b001:l035: Edge of black steel is Syrgak's warrior epithet, retained as a nominal fragment.
notes.manas-2010:p1345:b001:l041: The gray mule is the giant Kutan's mount, from which Syrgak strikes him down; not Syrgak's mount.
notes.manas-2010:p1346:b001:l021: Black spear and Achbolot both occur with drawing; zeugmatic source action retained rather than silently dropping the spear.
notes.manas-2010:p1346:b001:l025: Kneading the Chinese is the literal жууруу image of crushing in battle.
notes.manas-2010:p1346:b001:l031: Кан interpreted title khans for Muzburchak/Kökchö, with following blood-stained hands explicit; blood as a reading remains possible.
notes.manas-2010:p1347:b001:l012: Баабедин is the invoked holy figure Bahauddin, an established proper name, not an untranslated common-word utterance.
notes.manas-2010:p1347:b001:l017: Six tümen retained as epic army quantity, no exact equivalence imposed.
notes.manas-2010:p1347:b001:l029: Өң read as the all/entire collective emphatic in context; raw retained, not a claim about complexion.
notes.manas-2010:p1347:b001:l040: Калдай rendered governor in this sector description according to shared primary rank glossary; possible collective title-bearing host, not a newly invented tribe.
notes.manas-2010:p1347:b001:l042: Солоон is the Solon people in the neighboring army-sector list; retained as ethnonym.
notes.manas-2010:p1348:b001:l022: The unfinished conditional threat is retained without supplying a vow or consequence absent from raw.
notes.manas-2010:p1348:b001:l024: Printed кошуна provisionally read кошууну, army of the twelve khans, consistent with exact p1347:l033; raw retained.
notes.manas-2010:p1348:b001:l026: Yellow water is the explicit river modifier, not converted into a place named Yellow River.
notes.manas-2010:p1348:b001:l041: Printed этейин provisionally read нетейин in the rhetorical why-attack formula; raw dropped initial н retained.
